definitions.bx_mm: |bx| = |lateral component of the body landing-pose displacement (B - A)| in the frozen D56 canonical body frame. Recomputed from the real assignment_1024.csv + routes_l3d.json of the inherited state with route_builder.body_task (lifted body) or route_builder.direct_task (interface-direct body) and layer2d.canonical_frame; canonical_frame puts A at (0,0) heading +y, so bx is exactly the frame lateral coordinate of B.  For N/S ports it is |dx| between the two body landing points, for E/W ports |dy|.  The reported bx_mm / bx_old_mm is the inherited (pre-conversion) task; bx_new_mm is the same quantity of the converted state (reported for completeness).
definitions.bx_old_new_note: bx_new_mm differs from bx_old_mm only for 10 routes whose conversion turned a lifted adjacent-relation body into an interface-direct body: the direct task has no lead, so its landing poses (and therefore the canonical bx) change.  bx_old is the threshold quantity because it is the lateral offset the conversion had to re-express; the per-route difference is in bx_old_new_consistency_mm.
definitions.bx_geometry: world-frame cross-check computed directly from the stored body chain: v . (B - A) with u = source inward direction, v = (-u_y, u_x); reported as bx_geometry_old_mm / bx_geometry_new_mm.  It equals the canonical |bx| on every route (max difference 0.0 mm in this conversion), which validates the definition.
definitions.below_2R: a route is "below 2R" iff |bx| < 2R = 30.000 mm (R15 = 15.000 mm, frozen)
definitions.delta_commit: crossing change of the global total caused by replacing that single route during the sequential Stage-0 conversion (conversion_report.json records[].delta); only converted routes change, so the sum over records equals the global start->converted crossing delta
definitions.per_route_events: number of same-height crossing events the route participates in, from the independent crossing_stats.json of the start / converted states; not additive over routes (a 0 means the route has no crossing event in that state)
